basic_info.description: Situated at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this stunning top-floor residence in a charming 2-unit building is bathed in natural light & boasts remarkable architectural details throughout. Newly refinished & new bamboo hardwood floors & soaring 11-foot ceilings impart an air of timeless elegance. Period hardwood doors, thick baseboards, & bay French-pane windows further enhance the character & sophistication of this exceptional home. 3 spacious bedrooms, remodeled split bathroom, formal entry with beautiful new bamboo staircase, living room, dining room, remodeled eat-in kitchen with large island, pantry/storage closet, sunny walk-out view balcony, in-unit washer/dryer,  1 car tandem garage parking, storage area, common storage wall in garage, common landscaped sunny south facing garden/backyard with deck, bench, table, patio, lemon & fig trees, bamboo, mature cacti, blooming flowers, new gravel & mulch, irrigation & raised garden beds with lush greenery, tankless water heater, new wall heaters, newly painted interior. This prime South of Market location offers the perfect blend of urban convenience & modern comfort. Walk Score of 99! Close proximity to fine dining, lively nightlife venues, trendy cafes and easy access to highways 280/101, Muni, Bart, Caltrain and Downtown.
